scientific_integrity: The known variance series and innovation recurrence are explicitly credited to the motivating article. Only the three-scale singular-parameter expansion is new here; proof bounds cover all later labels.
scientific_limitations: The limit in tree size precedes the limit in the exponent.
No uniform joint size-exponent limit or monotonicity over all exponents is established.
Historical originality has not been independently certified.
title: Three-scale collapse of path-length variance in strongly root-biased recursive trees
